name: nemotron-tp2
_comment: Portable configuration example: host, user and private workspace paths are placeholders, not original measured infrastructure. Historical context follows; this is not a new qualification claim. Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, the qualified TP=2 profile (1M window, 16 slots, vision tower on rank 0, --spec auto, prefix cache Auto, graphs on) on two GB10 nodes. Serve it with `rexl3-cluster supervise` (the restart policy), never with a bare `up` in production: a lost group stays down by design. docs/NEMOTRON_TP_OPERATIONS.md. Set expected_hostname on each node for the host check; the paths are $HOME-relative on every node.

memory._comment: 33.38 GiB of weights on the larger rank (window 7 plan) plus the 1M KV pool, 16 slots of state, the cache arena, graphs

serve._comment: E1's long-prefill profile (docs/LONG_PREFILL_POLICY.md): 131,072 tokens of KV beside one 1M context so short requests are served during a 1M prefill, size-aware prefix eviction, a snapshot every 65,536 tokens of a long prefill. Its GPU legs (a 1M prefill with a co-tenant, per-rank memory with the headroom, deep-cancel resume at TP=2) are owed.
